# Bryan Berlandro Godlive

> Bryan Berlandro Godlive is a UI/UX Designer and Fullstack Developer based in Depok, Indonesia, with 3 years of experience. He designs in Figma and builds websites and web apps with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js. Available for projects.

This is a single-page portfolio. Everything below is on the homepage.
